scope: Fixed16 TRAIN batches, M95 eval forward, ONE same-forward capture. Only the selection rule changes; the checkpoint, the query set and all scores are untouched. `positive` selection is oracle because the training-positive set is defined with GT instance labels, so it is a causal test and an upper bound, never a deployable result. `anyseed` drops referent identity and keeps only objectness, so it shows how much of the effect survives without GT identity. Diagnosis only; no model, novelty or efficacy admission.
